about_the_game:
Play as the quirky Alfred in this 3D adventure game (demo). Explore the horrifyingly hostile alien mothership and attempt to escape your abductors. Having narrowly evaded a probing, Alfred must now avoid danger, solve interactive puzzles, and navigate the strange alien environment in what might be a futile effort to return home alive and unprobed!

The demo version gives you the chance to explore the first part of the alien mothership whilst getting to grips with the gameplay as well as showcasing the games immersive and creepy atmosphere. The demo provides you with the chance to solve a selection of some of the games interactive puzzles and sample some of the hazards that Alfred needs to avoid. The demo features some of the games interactive components giving an insight into Alfred's unusually quirky personality.

Alfred's Alien Abduction Adventure — probably the only quadruple-‘A’ game on the market today!! (joke)

Although this game is a complete work of fiction, it has been heavily inspired by real life accounts of alien abduction. Most notably the case of Travis Walton, who was reportedly abducted while working near Snowflake, Arizona, on November 5th, 1975.

Travis, if you happen to be reading this — THANK YOU for sharing your story. Without you and others like you, this game might never have been made.
